scope: Dedicated Briefstamp audit target CHECK, fail closed on a missing URL. No role, credential, FieldIssue or billing changes.

constraint.definition: CHECK ((((NOT (((payload -> 'source'::text) ->> 'target'::text) IS DISTINCT FROM 'sample'::text)) AND ((((payload -> 'source'::text) ->> 'url'::text) ~~ 'https://sample.flowproof.test/%'::text) IS TRUE)) OR ((NOT (((payload -> 'source'::text) ->> 'target'::text) IS DISTINCT FROM 'website'::text)) AND (NOT (((payload -> 'source'::text) ->> 'url'::text) IS DISTINCT FROM 'https://flowproof-demo.onrender.com/'::text)))))
